name: silent-hill-halo-of-flesh
description: Prototype fan-made non commercial de combat 2D consacré aux manifestations de Silent Hill : 230 fiches référencées, commandes contraintes par leur œuvre, chorégraphies lore et directeur de 123 lieux. Images et fidélité 1:1 suivies séparément dans le classeur de production.

scripts.verify: node scripts/build-production-reference.mjs && node scripts/build-sprites.mjs && node scripts/generate-docs.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --verify-only
scripts.build: node scripts/build-production-reference.mjs && node scripts/build-sprites.mjs && node scripts/generate-docs.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/build-production-reference.mjs && node scripts/build-sprites.mjs && node scripts/generate-docs.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --verify-only && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --verify
scripts.qa:browser: node scripts/http-qa-v090.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-sprites.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-art-v092.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-clips-v093.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-recovery-v094.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-boundaries-v095.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-presentations.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-reference-integration.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-chronicles.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-stage-bitmaps.mjs && node scripts/http-qa-alessa-weapons.mjs
